hypothesis: A G2 repair may validate the concrete CellOutput against the exact Grid10Plan and re-entry CellInput and compare only downstream_sha256, while leaving downstream_ref independently caller-supplied. That would preserve an alias-substitution gap despite adding typed output lineage.
counterhypothesis: Positive G2 sealing requires a bijective typed-output binding: the concrete CellOutput validates against the exact plan/input; the receipt/binding downstream digest equals CellOutput.sha256(); and the receipt/binding downstream_ref resolves to an exact member of that CellOutput.output_refs (or an equally explicit canonical output-identity field if the ABI is extended).

setup: Build one exact positive WP510 fixture with one UPTAKEN recipient and its exact re-entry CellInput.
Create a concrete CellOutput through CellOutput.for_input(plan, same_reentry_input, ...) with output_refs containing only downstream:real and record CellOutput.sha256().

All other G1/G2 identities remain exact.
preregistered_discriminator.control: The same fixture with downstream_ref=downstream:real and downstream_sha256=CellOutput.sha256() must remain admissible at repository-component scope.

secondary_falsifiers: Concrete CellOutput from the same plan/cell but a different CellInput must fail through Grid10Plan.validate_output because input_sha256 does not close to the exact re-entry input.
Concrete CellOutput whose output_refs match but whose canonical CellOutput.sha256 differs from receipt/binding downstream_sha256 must fail closed.

evidence_boundary: Preregistration only; no executed evidence yet.
